title: WONDERFULLY OUTSTANDING TOUR - EXCELLENT, CARING GUIDE
text: I had been greatly looking forward to this experience.  Because of the tour and the excellent guide, I was not disappointed.  I learned and saw so very many historical and religious sites and treasures.  The guide shared her personal story of why she was living in Cordoba and doing tours.  It made the overall experience even more special.
author: Alice_P

title: Amazing!
text: Worth the time. Amazing experience and history of the Mosque-Cathedral. The fit of the artistic achievements is incredible and also the boldness and showing of the Islamic religion architecture. A must for any history and architecture fan.
author: chinweb

title: Memorable and really interesting
text: Excellent tour guide. Very knowledgeable and passionate about everything. Very friendly, nothing too much trouble.
author: Jacqueline_D

title: Good experience
text: Very well organized, interesting guide, it was the second time I came to Cordoba to see this cathedral in the middle of the mosque
author: Laydevant R

title: A day immersed in history, customs, and food.
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our leisurely day to Cordoba.  We had a very informative guide who provided much historical, social, and culinary information.
author: mariogX8922NX

title: One of the most amazing centuries long layering of history
text: The Cordoba Mosque Cathedral is one of the most unique sites in the world. The long history, the original mosque contains a world class cathedral in the middle. Likely done in bad taste when the cathedral was built within this beautiful building, it is now just an amazement of historical culture. The description by the guide of the contents and layering of construction wonderful.
author: sandra_s

title: Cordoba Tour was Great
text: Angel holds intimate knowledge about the cathedral that has been passed on from his father, who was also a tour guide,  Excellent perspectives!  Great timing and pacing of the entire tour!
author: jarijison

title: Enjoyable trip
text: Cordoba is such a beautiful city. We got a a great introduction during our walking tour. Our guide took us all over old town showing us the various sights and explaining the history. Really enjoyable.
author: Judit_V

title: Relaxed day trip to Cordoba from Seville
text: We were picked up near our hotel by a comfortable bus.  We were met in Cordoba by our guide.  We had a break before the tour.  We toured the city Center and the Mezquita and had time for a nice lunch and to explore on our own before meeting the return bus.
author: Patricia_W

title: Very important
text:
